title: Coat hooks and shelves.
officialText:
Where coat hooks and shelves are provided in toilet rooms or toilet compartments, or in dressing,
fitting or locker rooms, at least one of each type shall be provided in accessible toilet rooms without toilet compartments, accessible
toilet compartments, and accessible dressing, fitting and locker rooms.
